label: Serious buyer
description: Offers a fair price and a concrete pickup time.
messages: Hi, is this still available? I can pay €120 and pick it up Saturday at 10:00.

label: Lowballer
description: Offers far below the suggested price.
messages: I'll take it for €20. Can you hold it for me?

label: Availability ghost
description: Asks if it is available, then disappears.

label: Payment-link scammer
description: Tries to move payment to a suspicious link.
messages: I paid already — use this payment link https://pay.example.invalid/claim and send it today.

label: Delivery asker
description: Asks for delivery on a pickup-only item.
messages: Could you deliver it? I know you said pickup, but it is free, right?
